ODS_VERSION.description: ODS version for update compatibility checks

ODS_MODE.description: LLM backend mode: local, cloud, hybrid, or lemonade (AMD)

ODS_MODEL_SWITCHBOARD.description: Model Switchboard rollout mode. enabled routes supported consumers through the stable ods/current alias.

LLM_API_URL.description: URL where all services send LLM requests

OPEN_WEBUI_LLM_BASE_URL.description: Optional Open WebUI OpenAI-compatible chat base URL override. Enabled switchboard installs set this to the LiteLLM gateway.

OPEN_WEBUI_LLM_API_KEY.description: Optional Open WebUI chat API key. Enabled switchboard installs use the LiteLLM key.

OPEN_WEBUI_TASK_MODEL.description: Exact ordinary-model ID for Open WebUI background tasks when Pixel is the default conversation model. Direct llama.cpp installs derive this from GGUF_FILE when empty.

LLM_URL.description: LLM base URL used by dashboard-api functional diagnostics. Leave empty to follow LLM_API_URL inside the Docker network.

REMOTE_LLM_ENABLED.description: Explicit remote-provider switch. Remote routing is valid only with ODS_MODE=cloud.

REMOTE_LLM_TRANSPORT.description: Remote provider transport profile: direct HTTPS or SSH transport.

REMOTE_LLM_BASE_URL.description: Remote OpenAI-compatible provider API root. The renderer normalizes host roots to /v1.

REMOTE_LLM_MODEL.description: Concrete remote model ID advertised by the provider.

REMOTE_LLM_TLS_CA_FILE.description: Optional private CA path for the remote provider transport. CA material is not stored in .env.

REMOTE_LLM_SSH_HOST.description: Explicit SSH server host used by the remote provider transport.

REMOTE_LLM_SSH_USER.description: Explicit SSH user used by the remote provider transport.

REMOTE_LLM_SSH_PORT.description: SSH server port used by the remote provider transport.

REMOTE_LLM_SSH_INFERENCE_HOST.description: Inference address as seen from the SSH server for SSH transport.

REMOTE_LLM_SSH_INFERENCE_PORT.description: Inference port as seen from the SSH server for SSH transport.

REMOTE_LLM_SSH_CONTROL_HOST.description: Optional ODS peer-control address as seen from the SSH server.

REMOTE_LLM_SSH_CONTROL_PORT.description: Optional ODS peer-control port as seen from the SSH server.

REMOTE_ODS_PEER_URL.description: Optional paired ODS control-plane root for authenticated ODS peer lifecycle support.

REMOTE_PROVIDER_DATA_GID.description: Numeric installation-owner data GID granted only to hardened remote-provider containers for mode-0640 lifecycle secret reads.

LLM_BACKEND.description: Inference backend. Current installers write llama-server, lemonade, litellm, or external; legacy values remain accepted for upgrade compatibility.

EXTERNAL_LLM_URL.description: Host-facing base URL of an installer-validated Ollama or LM Studio runtime. Configure with install.sh rather than editing this field alone.

EXTERNAL_LLM_CONTAINER_URL.description: Container-facing base URL derived from EXTERNAL_LLM_URL. Loopback hosts are normalized to host.docker.internal.

EXTERNAL_LLM_MODEL.description: Exact model id exposed by the selected external provider.

SKIP_MODEL_DOWNLOAD.description: Installer-owned receipt indicating that a validated external model replaces the ODS-managed GGUF download.

MODEL_PROFILE.description: Tier-aware local model family selection: qwen, gemma4, or auto

LLM_API_BASE_PATH.description: Base API path for the inference backend

ODS_TALK_VISION_URL.description: Optional OpenAI-compatible base URL for ODS Talk image attachments. Accepts either a host root or a base path ending in /v1 or /api/v1.

ODS_TALK_VISION_KEY.description: Optional bearer token for the ODS Talk vision backend.

ODS_TALK_VISION_MODEL.description: Vision-capable model id used by ODS Talk image attachments.

AMD_INFERENCE_RUNTIME.description: Explicit AMD local inference runtime selected by the installer. Empty when AMD local inference is not active.

AMD_INFERENCE_BACKEND.description: Explicit AMD acceleration backend used by the selected local inference runtime.

AMD_INFERENCE_LOCATION.description: Where the selected AMD local inference runtime is running from the dashboard-api container's perspective.

AMD_INFERENCE_PORT.description: Port used by the selected AMD local inference runtime. Defaults to the Lemonade api_port from config/backends/amd.json.

AMD_INFERENCE_SUPPORTED_BACKENDS.description: Comma-separated AMD accelerator backends declared by the installer for the selected runtime, such as rocm, vulkan, or rocm,vulkan.

AMD_INFERENCE_RUNTIME_MODE.description: Installer-declared AMD runtime mode for diagnostics.

AMD_INFERENCE_MANAGED.description: Whether the selected AMD inference runtime is managed by ODS.

TARGET_API_KEY.description: API key for Privacy Shield upstream target (set to LITELLM_KEY in lemonade mode)

HF_TOKEN.description: Optional read token for private or gated Hugging Face model repositories

ODS_MODEL_DOWNLOAD_ALLOWED_HOSTS.description: Comma-separated HTTPS hosts permitted for model artifact downloads

MINIMAX_API_KEY.description: MiniMax API key for MiniMax models (cloud/hybrid modes)

WEBUI_SECRET.description: Session signing secret for Open WebUI

LITELLM_LEMONADE_API_KEY.description: Outbound API key LiteLLM sends when calling the local Lemonade LLM backend (AMD installs only). Generated per-install at phase 06.

LEMONADE_EXTERNAL.description: True when ODS should wrap an existing Lemonade SDK service instead of starting its managed Lemonade runtime.

LEMONADE_BASE_URL.description: Host-side base URL for an existing Lemonade SDK service, without /v1 or /api/v1. Defaults to Lemonade's modern localhost service port.

LEMONADE_CONTAINER_BASE_URL.description: Container-side base URL for reaching the existing Lemonade SDK service, usually host.docker.internal with the Lemonade port.

LEMONADE_API_BASE_PATH.description: API path prefix for Lemonade OpenAI-compatible endpoints. ODS defaults to /api/v1 for Lemonade.

LEMONADE_MODEL.description: Model id to request from an existing Lemonade SDK service. Leave empty on managed ODS Lemonade installs, where GGUF_FILE is mapped to extra.<GGUF_FILE>.

ENABLE_PIXEL.description: Pixel selection policy: auto prefers Pixel on a qualified host; true requires Pixel; false selects the fallback.

PIXEL_AGENT_MODE.description: Resolved default agent selected by the installer.

PIXEL_SOURCE_URL.description: Bundled Pixel source (default); an authorized Git URL or owner-controlled absolute checkout is an explicit developer override.

PIXEL_SOURCE_REF.description: Immutable full lowercase Pixel commit SHA.

PIXEL_SOURCE_DIR.description: Secure owner-controlled parent directory for a local Pixel source checkout.

PIXEL_GATEWAY_PORT.description: Loopback-only Pixel gateway port selected at first installation and retained for reinstall reconciliation.

PIXEL_MODEL_RELAY_PORT.description: Pixel-only authenticated host-loopback model relay; LiteLLM and other consumers retain their existing route.

PIXEL_MODEL_RELAY_KEY.description: Installer-generated bearer token for Pixel's dedicated local model relay.

PIXEL_INFERENCE_PORT.description: Loopback-only port for optional, disabled-by-default Pixel inference sharing.

PIXEL_WEB_SEARCH_PROVIDER.description: Explicit native search choice. When absent, preserve existing Pixel onboarding; fresh installations use OpenClaw parallel-free without another ODS application. SearXNG remains an optional local provider.

PIXEL_PREVIEW_PORT.description: Dedicated loopback port for host-verified Pixel workspace previews.

PIXEL_OPENWEBUI_KEY.description: Installer-generated scoped bearer token for Open WebUI and Dashboard access to the internal Pixel edge only.

PIXEL_INGRESS_RUNTIME_DIR.description: Fixed host runtime directory containing the Pixel ingress socket and sanitized status projection.

PIXEL_PREVIEW_RUNTIME_DIR.description: Fixed host runtime directory containing the authenticated Pixel preview relay socket.

PIXEL_INGRESS_GID.description: Numeric GID of the host ods-pixel group granted access to the private ingress socket.

OPENCLAW_DANGEROUSLY_DISABLE_DEVICE_AUTH.description: Dangerous escape hatch that disables OpenClaw device pairing. Leave empty unless you fully accept unauthenticated LAN/Tailscale agent access risk.

BIND_ADDRESS.description: IP address for Docker port bindings. 127.0.0.1 (default) for localhost-only access. 0.0.0.0 for LAN access on headless servers. See SECURITY.md.

HOST_LAN_IP.description: Host machine's LAN IP, written by the installer when BIND_ADDRESS=0.0.0.0 so containers can announce the LAN address (e.g., openclaw allowedOrigins). Empty when binding only to localhost.

MAX_CONTEXT.description: Context window (installer variable, maps to CTX_SIZE)

GPU_BACKEND.description: GPU backend the installer detected: nvidia, amd, apple, cpu, jetson, or sycl (Intel Arc via oneAPI; detection may also record intel)

N_GPU_LAYERS.description: llama.cpp GPU layer offload policy: auto, all, or a non-negative layer count. CPU and Intel/Arc overlays may set an explicit numeric value.

LLAMA_BATCH_SIZE.description: llama.cpp prompt processing batch size. Higher values can improve prefill throughput but use more memory.

LLAMA_THREADS.description: CPU threads for llama.cpp non-GPU work.

HOST_RAM_GB.description: Unified system RAM in GB. macOS Apple Silicon only; the macOS env-generator writes it from sysctl hw.memsize and it is passed to llama.cpp for the Metal backend so it can size the unified-memory pool. Not written on Linux or Windows .env files. Not sensitive.

LLM_MODEL.description: Model name used by OpenClaw and dashboard

GGUF_URL.description: Integrity-pinned download URL for the active managed GGUF.

GGUF_SHA256.description: Optional SHA-256 integrity pin for the active managed GGUF.

ODS_ACTIVE_MODEL_STORE.description: Registered model store selected for native inference; default uses data/models

MODEL_SELECTION_SOURCE.description: Owner of the active model selection. Installer recommendations remain separate from Dashboard or operator choices.

MODEL_RECOMMENDED_MODEL.description: Installer-selected full local model. This remains the hardware recommendation even while a bootstrap model is temporarily loaded.

MODEL_RECOMMENDED_GGUF.description: GGUF filename for the installer-selected full local model.

MODEL_RECOMMENDED_CONTEXT.description: Context window selected by the installer for the recommended full local model.

MODEL_RECOMMENDATION_SOURCE.description: Source of the installer model recommendation, for dashboard display and diagnostics.

MODEL_RECOMMENDATION_POLICY.description: Versioned policy used to select the recommended full local model before any model is downloaded.

MODEL_RECOMMENDATION_CONFIDENCE.description: Confidence level for the installer model recommendation.

MODEL_RECOMMENDATION_REASON.description: Human-readable explanation for why the installer selected the recommended model.

MODEL_RECOMMENDED_ALTERNATIVES.description: Semicolon-delimited top catalog alternatives from the pre-download selector, encoded as id:context:estimated_required_gb.

MODEL_PERFORMANCE_SOURCE.description: Initial performance source for the recommended model before local benchmarking.

MODEL_PERFORMANCE_LABEL.description: Initial dashboard performance label for the recommended model before local benchmarking.

MODEL_RUNTIME_PROFILE.description: Optional catalog runtime profile applied to the selected model.

MODEL_RUNTIME_PROFILE_LABEL.description: User-facing label for the applied model runtime profile.

MODEL_RUNTIME_PROFILE_SOURCE.description: Reference URL for the applied model runtime profile.

LLAMA_SERVER_IMAGE.description: Optional llama.cpp container image override for model families that require newer runtime support

LLAMA_SERVER_IMAGE_FALLBACK.description: Optional explicit fallback image if a custom llama.cpp image tag disappears or fails to pull.

LEMONADE_SERVER_IMAGE.description: Optional AMD Lemonade container image override. AMD Linux installs default to the image pinned in config/backends/amd.json.

WHISPER_IMAGE.description: Optional speaches/whisper image override. Installers may set this to the CPU image when the NVIDIA driver is too old for the CUDA tag.

WHISPER_ACCELERATION.description: Whisper runtime acceleration selected independently from the primary LLM backend. NVIDIA installs fall back to cpu when the installed driver cannot run the CUDA image.

LLAMA_CPU_LIMIT.description: Auto-capped Docker CPU limit for llama-server

LLAMA_CPU_RESERVATION.description: Auto-capped Docker CPU reservation for llama-server

TTS_CPU_LIMIT.description: Auto-capped Docker CPU limit for Kokoro TTS

TTS_CPU_RESERVATION.description: Auto-capped Docker CPU reservation for Kokoro TTS

TTS_WORKERS.description: Kokoro TTS worker processes (one on native macOS or Docker guests below 12 GiB, two otherwise)

WHISPER_CPU_LIMIT.description: Auto-capped Docker CPU limit for Whisper STT

WHISPER_CPU_RESERVATION.description: Auto-capped Docker CPU reservation for Whisper STT

HERMES_CPU_LIMIT.description: Auto-capped Docker CPU limit for Hermes Agent

HERMES_CPU_RESERVATION.description: Auto-capped Docker CPU reservation for Hermes Agent

COMFYUI_CPU_LIMIT.description: Auto-capped Docker CPU limit for ComfyUI

COMFYUI_CPU_RESERVATION.description: Auto-capped Docker CPU reservation for ComfyUI

LLAMA_START_PERIOD.description: Healthcheck grace window for llama-server cold model load (Docker duration, e.g. 240s, 5m). Bump for 70B-class GGUFs on slow NVMe.

TIER.description: Hardware tier (1, 2, 3, 4, CLOUD, SH_COMPACT, SH_LARGE, NV_ULTRA)

BRAVE_SEARCH_API_KEY.description: Brave Search API subscription token (obtain at api.search.brave.com)

PERPLEXICA_SCRAPE_URL_MAX_CHARS.description: Maximum characters kept per URL from Perplexica scrape_url before synthesis

TOKEN_SPY_URL.description: Internal URL for Token Spy service (overridable for non-default deployments)

TOKEN_SPY_API_KEY.description: API key shared by Token Spy and dashboard-api; generated by the installer, with existing Token Spy key files preserved on upgrade

ODS_AGENT_KEY.description: API key for the ODS Host Agent (falls back to DASHBOARD_API_KEY if unset)

APE_API_KEY.description: API key for the APE (AI Proxy Engine) extension

SHIELD_API_KEY.description: API key for the Privacy Shield extension

OPENCODE_SERVER_PASSWORD.description: Optional password for a manually network-exposed OpenCode server. ODS-managed OpenCode is loopback-only and opens without a login.

WEBUI_AUTH.description: Enable Open WebUI authentication. ODS installers default to false on loopback and true for network-bound installs.

WEBUI_NAME.description: Open WebUI display + PWA install name. Surfaces as page title, app header, and the label next to the icon when the user adds ODS to their phone home screen.

WEBUI_URL.description: Optional Open WebUI public URL used for share links, OAuth callbacks, and PWA install metadata. Leave empty for traditional localhost usage. Set to http://chat.<ODS_DEVICE_NAME>.local after enabling ods-proxy + mDNS, or to a Tailscale Funnel / Cloudflare Tunnel / custom domain URL.

ODS_DEVICE_NAME.description: Device name used by mDNS announcement and as the hostname segment for proxy/headless URLs. Letters / digits / hyphens only.

WHISPER_URL.description: Internal Whisper STT URL used by dashboard-api and ODS Talk. Leave empty for the bundled whisper service.

AUDIO_STT_OPENAI_API_BASE_URL.description: OpenAI-compatible speech-to-text base URL used by Open WebUI.

AUDIO_STT_OPENAI_API_KEY.description: Optional API key for the Open WebUI speech-to-text backend.

AUDIO_STT_MODEL.description: Whisper STT model (HuggingFace repo ID). Auto-set by installer based on GPU backend: NVIDIA picks large-v3-turbo (faster, ~1.5GB), others pick base (~130MB). Edit in .env to override, then run `ods restart` (or reinstall).

TTS_URL.description: Internal Kokoro TTS URL used by dashboard-api and ODS Talk. Leave empty for the bundled tts service.

AUDIO_TTS_OPENAI_API_BASE_URL.description: OpenAI-compatible text-to-speech base URL used by Open WebUI.

AUDIO_TTS_OPENAI_API_KEY.description: Optional API key for the Open WebUI text-to-speech backend.

AUDIO_TTS_MODEL.description: Open WebUI/ODS Talk text-to-speech model id.

AUDIO_TTS_VOICE.description: Open WebUI/ODS Talk Kokoro voice id.

N8N_AUTH.description: Deprecated: n8n v2.x has built-in user management. This variable is ignored.

N8N_RUN_USER.description: Override the n8n container user. Native macOS uses node; otherwise Compose defaults to ODS_UID:ODS_GID.

N8N_WEBHOOK_URL.description: n8n webhook URL for external access

N8N_SECURE_COOKIE.description: n8n session-cookie policy. auto disables Secure only for loopback HTTP and enables it for HTTPS or non-loopback binds.

N8N_PROXY_HOPS.description: Number of trusted reverse proxies in front of n8n.

EMBEDDING_MODEL.description: Canonical Hugging Face model repository loaded by bundled TEI and used as the first-boot Open WebUI RAG default. Existing Open WebUI installs retain their Admin Panel value. GGUF/Q4 model files are not compatible with this runtime.

RAG_EMBEDDING_MODEL.description: Optional first-boot Open WebUI embedding-model override. Leave empty to use EMBEDDING_MODEL. Existing Open WebUI installs must also update the persistent Admin Panel value. Use a different model only with a matching external RAG_OPENAI_API_BASE_URL.

RAG_OPENAI_API_BASE_URL.description: OpenAI-compatible embeddings endpoint used by Open WebUI. Leave empty for the bundled TEI service.

RAG_OPENAI_API_KEY.description: Optional API key for an authenticated external OpenAI-compatible RAG embeddings endpoint.

EMBEDDINGS_MEMORY_LIMIT.description: Docker memory limit for the bundled TEI embeddings service, for example 4G or 6G.

EMBEDDING_URL.description: Embedding service URL used by dashboard-api functional diagnostics. Leave empty for the bundled embeddings service.

VIDEO_GID.description: GID of the 'video' group on the host (used in container group_add for AMD GPU access)

RENDER_GID.description: GID of the 'render' group on the host (used in container group_add for AMD GPU access)

ONEAPI_DEVICE_SELECTOR.description: oneAPI device filter for the Intel Arc (SYCL) llama-server build. Phase 06 writes 'level_zero:gpu' when GPU_BACKEND=sycl so the runtime binds the Arc GPU through Level Zero; see docs/INTEL-ARC-GUIDE.md.

SYCL_CACHE_PERSISTENT.description: Persist the SYCL kernel JIT cache across container starts (1 = on). Phase 06 writes it for GPU_BACKEND=sycl; without it every llama-server start recompiles kernels (~30s).

ZES_ENABLE_SYSMAN.description: Enable Level Zero Sysman so the Intel Arc runtime can report GPU memory (1 = on). Phase 06 writes it for GPU_BACKEND=sycl.

HSA_OVERRIDE_GFX_VERSION.description: ROCm HSA gfx-target override (HSA-version format, e.g. '11.5.1' for gfx1151). Phase 06 sets this only when the detected gfx target is gfx1151 (Strix Halo, not in ROCm's native support list). Leave unset on natively-supported parts (gfx942/MI300X, gfx90a/MI250, gfx1100/RX 7900) — setting it on those crashes model-load with HSA_STATUS_ERROR_INVALID_ISA.

HSA_XNACK.description: AMD ROCm extended memory access for large KV caches

AMDGPU_TARGET.description: AMD gfx target used as a Docker build arg for the custom llama.cpp ROCm image (e.g. gfx1151, gfx942, gfx90a, gfx1100). Phase 06 auto-detects this from GPU_TOPOLOGY_JSON; override only if the detection is wrong.

LLAMA_CPP_REF.description: llama.cpp release tag to build (pin to avoid breakage)

ODS_UID.description: Host user ID persisted for Docker Compose service ownership without colliding with Bash's readonly UID variable

ODS_GID.description: Host group ID persisted for Docker Compose service ownership

UID.description: Deprecated container user ID key retained for existing .env files; installers migrate it to ODS_UID

GID.description: Deprecated container group ID key retained for existing .env files; installers migrate it to ODS_GID

LLAMA_SERVER_MEMORY_LIMIT.description: Docker memory limit for NVIDIA llama-server. Installers derive a host-safe value when this is unset; an existing value is preserved. Remove the generated key before rerunning the installer to recalculate after Docker memory changes.

ENABLE_WEB_SEARCH.description: Enable web search in Open WebUI

ANYTHINGLLM_JWT_SECRET.description: JWT secret for session tokens (auto-generated by setup.sh)

FLOWISE_USERNAME.description: Admin username for Flowise UI (default: admin)

FLOWISE_PASSWORD.description: Admin password for Flowise UI (auto-generated by setup.sh)

JWT_SECRET.description: JWT signing secret for user sessions (auto-generated by setup.sh)

JWT_REFRESH_SECRET.description: JWT refresh token secret (auto-generated by setup.sh)

LIBRECHAT_MONGO_PASSWORD.description: MongoDB root password for librechat-mongodb (auto-generated by setup.sh)

LIBRECHAT_MEILI_KEY.description: Meilisearch master key for librechat-meilisearch (auto-generated by setup.sh)

PAPERLESS_SECRET_KEY.description: Django secret key for session security (auto-generated by setup.sh)

WEAVIATE_API_KEY.description: API key for Weaviate authentication (auto-generated by setup.sh)

DIFY_SECRET_KEY.description: Dify secret key for API access

ENABLE_IMAGE_GENERATION.description: Enable image generation in Open WebUI (requires ComfyUI)

GPU_COUNT.description: Number of GPUs detected at install time

SYSTEM_RAM_GB.description: System RAM budget recorded during install for model runtime profile matching. On WSL this is the VM-visible RAM after reserving control-plane headroom.

LLAMA_SERVER_GPU_UUIDS.description: GPU UUIDs assigned to llama-server (comma-separated, used by NVIDIA_VISIBLE_DEVICES)

LLAMA_REASONING.description: llama.cpp reasoning/thinking mode: off (default) | auto | on. Off prevents thinking models from consuming the entire token budget on internal reasoning.

LLAMA_ARG_FLASH_ATTN.description: llama.cpp Flash Attention mode. Use 'on' for long-context performance tuning when the selected backend supports it.

LLAMA_ARG_CACHE_TYPE_K.description: llama.cpp KV cache key type. q8_0 reduces long-context memory pressure versus f16.

LLAMA_ARG_CACHE_TYPE_V.description: llama.cpp KV cache value type. q8_0 reduces long-context memory pressure versus f16.

LLAMA_ARG_N_CPU_MOE.description: Optional llama.cpp MoE tuning knob (--n-cpu-moe). Keeps the first N MoE expert layers on CPU/RAM. Leave unset for dense models.

LLAMA_SERVER_GPU_INDICES.description: GPU indices assigned to llama-server (comma-separated, used by ROCR_VISIBLE_DEVICES on AMD)

LLAMA_ARG_NO_CACHE_PROMPT.description: Optional llama.cpp boolean flag (--no-cache-prompt) used by specific long-context runtime profiles.

LLAMA_ARG_CHECKPOINT_EVERY_N_TOKENS.description: Optional llama.cpp long-context checkpoint interval. Some experimental profiles set -1 to disable checkpoints.

LLAMA_ARG_CHECKPOINT_MIN_SPACING_NT.description: Optional native llama.cpp --checkpoint-min-step. Requires explicit runtime support; do not combine with the legacy checkpoint interval.

LLAMA_PARALLEL.description: llama.cpp --parallel request slots. Advanced 8GB MoE profiles keep this at 1 to preserve VRAM headroom.

LLAMA_ARG_SPEC_TYPE.description: Optional llama.cpp speculative decoding mode (--spec-type). Use only with a llama.cpp build and GGUF that explicitly support the selected mode, e.g. draft-mtp or ngram-mod,draft-mtp.

LLAMA_ARG_SPEC_DRAFT_TYPE_K.description: Optional llama.cpp speculative draft key cache type

LLAMA_ARG_SPEC_DRAFT_TYPE_V.description: Optional llama.cpp speculative draft value cache type

LLAMA_ARG_SPEC_DRAFT_N_MAX.description: Optional llama.cpp speculative draft token cap (--spec-draft-n-max). For current MTP-capable GGUFs this is commonly tuned by benchmark; leave unset for normal models.

LLAMA_ARG_SPLIT_MODE.description: llama.cpp split mode (LLAMA_ARG_SPLIT_MODE): none | layer (pipeline) | row (tensor/hybrid)

LLAMA_ARG_TENSOR_SPLIT.description: llama.cpp tensor split weights (LLAMA_ARG_TENSOR_SPLIT): comma-separated proportions e.g. 3,1

EMBEDDINGS_GPU_UUID.description: GPU UUID assigned to embeddings service (NVIDIA)

EMBEDDINGS_GPU_INDEX.description: GPU index for embeddings service (AMD, used as ROCR_VISIBLE_DEVICES)

COMFYUI_GPU_INDEX.description: GPU index for ComfyUI (AMD, used as ROCR_VISIBLE_DEVICES)

WHISPER_GPU_INDEX.description: GPU index for Whisper service (AMD, used as ROCR_VISIBLE_DEVICES)

ROCR_VISIBLE_DEVICES.description: AMD GPU indices visible to ROCm runtime (comma-separated, e.g. '0,1,2')

LEMONADE_LLAMACPP.description: Lemonade inner llama.cpp backend selector for AMD multi-GPU. Applied by docker-compose.multigpu-amd.yml. Lemonade's schema accepts only auto|vulkan|cpu; 'auto' plus LEMONADE_LLAMACPP_ROCM_BIN picks up the custom ROCm-built binary.

LEMONADE_LLAMACPP_ROCM_BIN.description: Path inside the llama-server container to a custom ROCm-built llama-server binary. Phase 06 sets this to /opt/llama-custom/llama-server only when the detected gfx target is gfx1151 (the custom binary is built with Strix-Halo-specific patches — MMQ tile size + AMDGPU_TARGET=gfx1151 — and either ISA-faults or runs perf-regressed on other architectures). Empty / unset → Lemonade uses its bundled ROCm-aware binary, which works for gfx942/MI300X and other natively-supported parts.

LLM_MODEL_SIZE_MB.description: Approximate model file size in MB (used for multi-GPU memory planning)

LITELLM_MASTER_KEY.description: LiteLLM master API key for proxy authentication

APE_RATE_LIMIT_RPM.description: APE per-minute policy check rate limit.

APE_STRICT_MODE.description: When true, APE blocks policy violations instead of only logging advisory decisions.

OPENCLAW_LLM_URL.description: Optional OpenClaw provider base URL override, mainly for routing OpenClaw traffic through monitoring/proxy layers.

OPENCLAW_HTTP_API.description: Opt-in OpenClaw OpenAI-compatible HTTP shim. Leave empty unless you are deliberately exposing the shim for advanced integrations.

ODS_AGENT_BIND.description: Bind address for the ODS Host Agent HTTP server. Defaults to 127.0.0.1 on macOS/Windows, ods-network gateway IP on Linux, then Docker bridge gateway, then 127.0.0.1.

ODS_AGENT_PORT.description: Host Agent HTTP port used by dashboard-api to request privileged host operations such as .env writes and service recreation.

ODS_AGENT_HOST.description: Hostname or IP that dashboard-api containers use to reach the ODS Host Agent. Docker Desktop uses host.docker.internal; Colima uses its private vmnet host gateway.

ODS_PYTHON_CMD.description: Python interpreter that ODS shell helpers must use, recorded by the installer when the host python3 cannot import yaml (the compose resolver requires PyYAML). Empty means detect at runtime.

ODS_MACOS_HOST_GATEWAY.description: Private macOS host-side vmnet address used by Colima containers to reach loopback-only ODS services.

ODS_MACOS_VM_IP.description: Colima VM address authorized to connect to the private macOS host-service bridges.

ODS_MACOS_LLM_BRIDGE_ENABLED.description: Whether the private Colima-to-native-llama bridge is managed by the macOS installer.

ODS_MACOS_HOST_AGENT_BRIDGE_ENABLED.description: Whether the private Colima-to-host-agent bridge is managed by the macOS installer.

ODS_NATIVE_LLAMA_PORT.description: Loopback-only native llama-server port behind the macOS Colima bridge.

ODS_TIER.description: Hardware tier classification (0-4, SH_LARGE, SH_COMPACT, NV_ULTRA, CLOUD)

HW_CLASS.description: Hardware class identifier from capability profile

ODS_SESSION_SECRET.description: HMAC signing secret for the ods-session cookie. dashboard-api uses this to sign at magic-link redemption; the Hermes auth-proxy uses /api/auth/verify-session to validate. Generate with `openssl rand -hex 32`. Rotating kicks all current sessions.

HERMES_DASHBOARD_SESSION_TOKEN.description: Internal Hermes dashboard and WebSocket session token. The installer generates and preserves it so browser sessions survive Hermes container restarts.

ODS_PUBLIC_URL.description: Public base URL used by dashboard-api when generating invite and magic-link URLs for custom domains, tunnels, or Tailscale Funnel. Leave empty for normal mDNS/LAN URL generation.

ODS_SERVICE_PUBLIC_URLS.description: Optional JSON object mapping service ids to their public browser URLs when an external reverse proxy is used, for example {"open-webui":"https://chat.example.com","comfyui":"https://comfy.example.com"}.

ODS_CHAT_PUBLIC_URL.description: Optional public chat redirect URL for magic-link redemption. Defaults to OPEN_WEBUI_PUBLIC_URL or ODS_PUBLIC_URL/chat when public mode is used.

ODS_HERMES_PUBLIC_URL.description: Optional public Hermes redirect URL for magic-link redemption. Defaults to HERMES_PROXY_PUBLIC_URL or ODS_PUBLIC_URL/hermes when public mode is used.

ODS_TALK_PUBLIC_URL.description: Optional public ODS Talk redirect URL for owner-card magic links. Defaults to ODS_PUBLIC_URL/talk when public mode is used.

OPEN_WEBUI_PUBLIC_URL.description: Optional public browser URL for Open WebUI when served through an external reverse proxy.

COMFYUI_PUBLIC_URL.description: Optional public browser URL for ComfyUI when served through an external reverse proxy.

N8N_PUBLIC_URL.description: Optional public browser URL for n8n when served through an external reverse proxy.

HERMES_PROXY_PUBLIC_URL.description: Optional public browser URL for Hermes proxy when served through an external reverse proxy.

WHISPER_PUBLIC_URL.description: Optional public browser URL for Whisper STT when served through an external reverse proxy.

TTS_PUBLIC_URL.description: Optional public browser URL for Kokoro TTS when served through an external reverse proxy.

OPENCODE_PUBLIC_URL.description: Optional public browser URL for OpenCode when served through an external reverse proxy.

ODS_COOKIE_DOMAIN.description: Cookie domain for ods-session SSO across dashboard/chat/auth/hermes subdomains. Empty keeps cookies host-only; proxy installs commonly use <device>.local.

ODS_PROXY_PORT.description: Host port for the ODS reverse proxy (Caddy). Default 80 — standard HTTP. The proxy is opt-in via `ods enable ods-proxy`.

ODS_PROXY_TLS_PORT.description: Host port for HTTPS (deferred; HTTP only in v1). Default 443.

ODS_PROXY_BIND.description: Bind address for the reverse proxy's host port. Defaults to 0.0.0.0 (LAN-exposed) — that's the whole point of the proxy. Override to 127.0.0.1 to keep it localhost-only.

HERMES_LLM_BASE_URL.description: OpenAI-compatible endpoint Hermes Agent talks to. Defaults to ODS's llama-server.

HERMES_LLM_API_KEY.description: Dummy API key for Hermes Agent's OpenAI SDK (llama-server doesn't validate it, but the SDK requires the field to be non-empty).

HERMES_AGENT_IMAGE.description: Container image used for Hermes Agent. Defaults to a reviewed upstream version tag; override only for deliberate hotfix testing.

HERMES_AGENT_IMAGE_FALLBACK.description: Optional explicit fallback Hermes Agent image. Phase 08 uses it only if HERMES_AGENT_IMAGE cannot be resolved.

HERMES_LANGUAGE.description: UI language for Hermes Agent's web dashboard (defaults to en).

SEARXNG_URL.description: SearXNG URL used by Hermes web tools. Defaults to the bundled searxng service on the Docker network.

WHATSAPP_ENABLED.description: Enable Hermes's optional WhatsApp gateway integration. Disabled by default.

WHATSAPP_ALLOWED_USERS.description: Comma-separated WhatsApp user IDs or phone numbers allowed to talk to Hermes.

WHATSAPP_REQUIRE_MENTION.description: Require a mention/prefix before Hermes replies in WhatsApp chats.

WHATSAPP_FREE_RESPONSE_CHATS.description: Comma-separated WhatsApp chat IDs where Hermes may respond without an explicit mention.

WHATSAPP_REPLY_PREFIX.description: Optional prefix added to Hermes WhatsApp replies.

HERMES_PROXY_PORT.description: External port for the Hermes auth-proxy (Caddy sidecar that gates LAN access by verifying the ods-session cookie via dashboard-api's /api/auth/verify-session endpoint).

HERMES_PROXY_UPSTREAM.description: Internal upstream the Hermes auth-proxy forwards to. Defaults to ods-hermes:9119.

ODS_AUTH_UPSTREAM.description: Where Caddy forward_auth sends its session-verify sub-request. Defaults to the in-network dashboard-api container; override if dashboard-api lives elsewhere.

HERMES_PROXY_AUTH_DOCS_URL.description: Optional docs/help URL shown on the Hermes auth-required page when a visitor lacks a valid ods-session cookie.

TS_AUTHKEY.description: Tailscale auth key (tskey-auth-...). Generate at https://login.tailscale.com/admin/settings/keys. Consumed once on first join; the daemon caches the node key in data/tailscale/.

TS_HOSTNAME.description: Hostname this device registers as on the Tailscale net. Defaults to ODS_DEVICE_NAME. Reachable as <hostname>.<tailnet>.ts.net once joined.

TS_EXTRA_ARGS.description: Optional extra flags passed to `tailscale up`, such as --advertise-tags=tag:ods after your tailnet ACL defines and authorizes that tag.

OFFLINE_MODE.description: Air-gapped operation. install-core.sh defaults this to false and --offline sets it true; phase 09 then appends this block to .env.

DISABLE_TELEMETRY.description: Suppress telemetry for an air-gapped install. Written as true by phase 09 under --offline.

DISABLE_UPDATE_CHECK.description: Suppress update checks for an air-gapped install. Written as true by phase 09 under --offline.

WEB_SEARCH_ENABLED.description: Allow web search. Phase 09 writes false under --offline so the stack does not reach the network.

LOCAL_RAG_ENABLED.description: Prefer local RAG over web search. Phase 09 writes true under --offline.

MINIFLUX_BASE_URL.description: Miniflux client-facing URL; update when changing the published port or hostname

NTFY_BASE_URL.description: ntfy client-facing URL; update when changing the published port or hostname

MINIFLUX_DB_PASSWORD.description: Password for the private PostgreSQL database; retain after initialization

MINIFLUX_ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Initial Miniflux admin password; later changes use the Miniflux UI

BRAVE_SEARCH_SEARXNG_COMPAT.description: Set to 1 to expose a searxng-compatible /search?format=json route for consumers like Perplexica

PERPLEXICA_SEARXNG_API_URL.description: Explicit SearXNG-compatible search endpoint; leave empty to preserve Perplexica's current setting

PIXEL_INGRESS_SOCKET.description: Unix-domain socket path the ingress listens on. UDS only, never TCP.

PIXEL_GATEWAY_TOKEN_FILE.description: Restricted owner-private OpenClaw config containing the gateway token.

PIXEL_STATUS_FILE.description: Sanitized status projection path written on startup and interval.

PIXEL_STATUS_INTERVAL_MS.description: Interval in ms between status projection writes.

ODS_REMOTE_PROVIDER_ROUTE_PATH.description: Generated remote routing-state path mounted read-only into the egress service.

ODS_REMOTE_PROVIDER_POLICY_PATH.description: Versioned egress policy document mounted read-only into the egress service.

ODS_REMOTE_PROVIDER_API_KEY_FILE.description: Private provider bearer token file. The value is never projected into public env/config.

ODS_REMOTE_PROVIDER_SSH_TUNNEL_HEALTH_UR.description: Internal SSH tunnel readiness endpoint used only for SSH transport health gating.

ODS_REMOTE_PROVIDER_SSH_TUNNEL_HEALTH_TI.description: Seconds the egress service waits for the internal SSH tunnel health endpoint.

ODS_REMOTE_PROVIDER_SECRET_DIR.description: Private SSH identity and known_hosts custody directory mounted read-only into the SSH tunnel service.

ODS_REMOTE_PROVIDER_SSH_STATUS_PORT.description: Internal-only health/status port for the SSH tunnel supervisor scaffold.

ODS_REMOTE_PROVIDER_SSH_RECONCILE_INTERV.description: Seconds between route/secret custody reconciliation loops.

ODS_REMOTE_PROVIDER_SSH_START_GRACE.description: Seconds a newly started SSH child must stay alive before health reports ready.

ODS_REMOTE_PROVIDER_SSH_RESTART_COOLDOWN.description: Seconds to wait before restarting an exited SSH child.

ODS_REMOTE_PROVIDER_SSH_STOP_TIMEOUT.description: Seconds to wait for an old SSH child to terminate before killing it.

BARK_USE_SMALL_MODELS.description: Use smaller/faster Bark models (less VRAM, slightly lower quality)

BARK_OFFLOAD_CPU.description: Offload Bark models to CPU between requests (reduces VRAM usage)

BARK_API_KEY.description: API key for Bark TTS service authentication (optional; leave empty to disable auth)

BOOKSTACK_APP_KEY.description: Stable Laravel encryption key, base64 followed by a colon and base64 encoding of 32 random bytes. Preserve it with backups.

BOOKSTACK_DB_PASSWORD.description: Dedicated database password. Use at least 24 random alphanumeric characters; preserve it after initialization.

BOOKSTACK_URL.description: Browser origin including port, normally http://localhost:11148. Changing this later requires BookStack URL migration.

CHANGEDETECTION_PASSWORD.description: Required web login password, converted in memory to upstream salted PBKDF2 format on startup.

CHANGEDETECTION_BASE_URL.description: Browser URL used for links; adjust if publishing on a different local port.

CHANGEDETECTION_TIMEZONE.description: IANA timezone for user-configured watch schedules.

CLICKHOUSE_PASSWORD.description: Strong password for the local ods database user. Keep with configuration backups.

CODE_SERVER_PASSWORD.description: Strong password required to access the editor and its container terminal.

CONVERTX_JWT_SECRET.description: Persistent random login-token signing secret; use at least 32 random characters.

COUCHDB_PASSWORD.description: Initial password for the ods administrator. Use a single-line password; later changes are managed in CouchDB and persisted.

DIFY_EXTERNAL_URL.description: External URL for Dify - used in API responses and redirects

DIFY_OPENAI_API_BASE.description: OpenAI-compatible API endpoint for LLM backend

DISTRIBUTION_PASSWORD.description: Random 64-hex password for local registry user ods; reapplied on startup.

DISTRIBUTION_HTTP_SECRET.description: Distinct stable random 64-hex secret for registry upload state.

DOCUSEAL_SECRET_KEY_BASE.description: Stable random application secret: generate 64 random bytes as 128 hex characters and preserve it with backups.

DUFS_PASSWORD.description: Password for ods, at least 12 bytes; exclude colon, at-sign, pipe, line breaks and crypt-hash prefix.

ETHERPAD_USER_PASSWORD.description: Password for the non-administrator user account.

ETHERPAD_ADMIN_SECRET.description: Random secret for the built-in admin OAuth client.

ETHERPAD_USER_SECRET.description: Independent random secret for the built-in user OAuth client.

EVIDENTLY_SECRET.description: Secret required by SDK clients to write evaluation reports.

FILEBROWSER_QUANTUM_ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Initial password for the admin account; use the application account controls for later changes.

FILEBROWSER_QUANTUM_JWT_SECRET.description: Persistent random signing secret for login tokens; at least 32 random characters recommended.

FLARUM_DB_PASSWORD.description: Stable random 64-hex database password; changing environment alone does not rotate an initialized database.

FRESHRSS_TIMEZONE.description: IANA timezone for feed refresh scheduling.

FRESHRSS_CRON_MIN.description: Minutes within each hour for refresh; default twice hourly.

GAIA_AGENT_UI_VERSION.description: Agent UI npm package version to install when building the container.

GAIA_LEMONADE_BASE_URL.description: Remote Lemonade/OpenAI-compatible API base URL for GAIA, usually ending in /api/v1.

GAIA_SKIP_GAIA_INIT.description: Skip GAIA's first-run Lemonade/model bootstrap to avoid automatic model downloads.

GAIA_UI_SERVE_ONLY.description: Serve only the Agent UI static frontend without starting the GAIA Python backend.

GAIA_DISABLE_UPDATE.description: Disable Agent UI auto-update checks inside the container.

GARAGE_RPC_SECRET.description: Stable 64-hex node RPC secret; preserve with the metadata backup.

GATUS_ENDPOINT.description: HTTP(S) endpoint reachable from the container that should return 200. No embedded credentials.

GITEA_SSH_PORT.description: External port for Gitea SSH access

GITEA_APP_NAME.description: Display name for the Gitea instance

GOTIFY_ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Initial administrator password; existing accounts are not reset by changing this value.

GRAFANA_ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: 64-hex initial administrator password for ods; existing users are not reset.

GRAFANA_SECRET_KEY.description: Distinct stable 64-hex key protecting stored data-source credentials; preserve with backups.

GRIST_OWNER_EMAIL.description: Local single-user document identity, not a password or verified login.

GRIST_SESSION_SECRET.description: Persistent random session signing secret; use at least 32 random characters.

GROCY_TZ.description: IANA timezone used by the grocery service.

HEALTHCHECKS_DB_PASSWORD.description: Distinct 64-hex PostgreSQL password; retain for existing data.

HEDGEDOC_DATABASE_PASSWORD.description: Persistent password for the dedicated notes database.

HEDGEDOC_SESSION_SECRET.description: Persistent random session signing secret; use at least 32 random characters.

HEDGEDOC_DOMAIN.description: Browser hostname and port, without scheme. Update with the published port.

HEDGEDOC_ALLOW_REGISTER.description: Allow local email/password account registration; false keeps account creation in the upstream CLI.

HOMEBOX_API_KEY_PEPPER.description: Stable random secret of at least 32 bytes for API-key hashing; retain with backups.

HOMEBOX_ALLOW_REGISTRATION.description: Enable first-account registration; set false and restart after creating the owner account.

HOMEPAGE_AUTH_PASSWORD.description: Password for the Homepage dashboard; not the ODS account password.

HOMEPAGE_AUTH_SECRET.description: Persistent random session signing secret, at least 32 characters. Rotation invalidates sessions.

HOMEPAGE_EXTERNAL_URL.description: Exact browser origin for password sign-in. Update when changing port or hostname.

HOMEPAGE_ALLOWED_HOSTS.description: Comma-separated Host headers without schemes. Include homepage:3000 for ODS readiness; do not use a wildcard.

HOMEPAGE_VAR_ODS_URL.description: Browser URL of this ODS installation for the initial Portal link.

HOPPSCOTCH_DB_PASSWORD.description: 64 random hexadecimal characters for the dedicated PostgreSQL account.

HOPPSCOTCH_ENCRYPTION_KEY.description: Stable 32-hex data-encryption key; retain with database backups.

HUGINN_DATABASE_PASSWORD.description: Persistent password for the private Huginn PostgreSQL database.

HUGINN_SECRET_TOKEN.description: Persistent random Rails secret, at least 64 random characters.

HUGINN_ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Strong initial owner password; does not reset an existing account.

HUGINN_INVITATION_CODE.description: Private invitation code needed for additional registrations.

HUGINN_TIMEZONE.description: Application timezone name supported by Rails.

INFLUXDB_ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Initial ods administrator password: random 64 hexadecimal characters.

INFLUXDB_ADMIN_TOKEN.description: Distinct random 64-hex initial operator token. Keep private; create scoped project tokens separately.

INVOICESHELF_KEY.description: Stable random 64-hex encryption key; preserve with backups and never replace casually.

KANBOARD_INITIAL_PASSWORD.description: Initial admin password, 12–72 UTF-8 bytes. Existing passwords are not reset.

KARAKEEP_AUTH_SECRET.description: Persistent random session-signing secret; use at least 36 random bytes.

KARAKEEP_SEARCH_KEY.description: Private search index key, at least 16 random characters; keep across restarts.

KARAKEEP_URL.description: Browser-facing URL; match the host port and any intentional reverse proxy.

KARAKEEP_DISABLE_SIGNUPS.description: Set true after creating the intended local accounts.

KESTRA_ADMIN_EMAIL.description: Administrator email address for initial Basic Auth setup.

KESTRA_ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Administrator password, at least eight characters with uppercase and a number.

KESTRA_MANAGEMENT_PASSWORD.description: Separate random password for the internal management endpoints.

KESTRA_URL.description: Browser-facing URL; update when changing the host port.

KEYCLOAK_BOOTSTRAP_PASSWORD.description: Distinct random 64-hex initial temporary administrator password, not an existing-account reset.

CREDS_KEY.description: AES-128 encryption key for stored credentials (auto-generated by setup.sh)

CREDS_IV.description: AES initialization vector for credential encryption (auto-generated by setup.sh)

LIBRETRANSLATE_LANGUAGES.description: Comma-separated Argos language codes to install.

LIGHTRAG_API_KEY.description: Private access key for the LightRAG UI/API.

LIGHTRAG_EMBEDDING_DIM.description: Exact embedding dimension from the active embedding service; changing it requires reindexing.

LIGHTRAG_EMBEDDING_TOKEN_LIMIT.description: Actual maximum input tokens supported by the active embedding model.

LIGHTRAG_MAX_TOTAL_TOKENS.description: Retrieval context budget below the selected chat model context, leaving room for instructions and output.

LIMESURVEY_DB_PASSWORD.description: 64-hex database password; preserve for existing PostgreSQL data.

LIMESURVEY_ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Distinct 64-hex initial administrator password; existing accounts are not reset.

LIMESURVEY_ADMIN_EMAIL.description: Actual owner email address for initial administrator account.

LINKWARDEN_DATABASE_PASSWORD.description: Random URL-safe database password (letters and digits, at least 32 characters).

LINKWARDEN_SEARCH_KEY.description: Private search index key, at least 16 random characters.

LINKWARDEN_AUTH_URL.description: Browser-facing authentication URL including /api/v1/auth; match any custom port.

LINKWARDEN_DISABLE_REGISTRATION.description: Set true after creating the intended owner accounts.

LISTMONK_DB_PASSWORD.description: 64-hex PostgreSQL password; preserve for existing database.

LISTMONK_ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Distinct 64-hex initial password for ods administrator; does not reset an existing account.

LLDAP_ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Initial admin password, at least 12 characters. Existing passwords are preserved.

LLDAP_JWT_SECRET.description: Persistent random session signing secret, at least 32 characters.

LLDAP_KEY_SEED.description: Persistent random password-protection key seed, at least 32 characters. Back up with database.

LOCALRECALL_API_KEY.description: At least 24 random ASCII characters without spaces or commas. Browser username is ods; this key is the password and API Bearer token.

MAILPIT_UI_AUTH.description: UI credentials in username:password format; separate multiple pairs with spaces. No whitespace inside a username/password.

MAILPIT_SMTP_AUTH.description: SMTP credentials in username:password format; use separate development-only credentials.

MAILPIT_SMTP_PORT.description: Loopback host port for SMTP capture, separate from the web UI port.

MARIMO_TOKEN.description: 64-hex editor authentication token; holders can execute notebook code.

MEILISEARCH_MASTER_KEY.description: Search API master key, at least 16 characters.

MERMAID_LIVE_EDITOR_PORT.description: Mermaid Live Editor published host port

METABASE_DATABASE_PASSWORD.description: Persistent password for the private application PostgreSQL database.

METABASE_ENCRYPTION_KEY.description: Persistent encryption key, at least 16 characters; generate 32 random bytes and retain with backups.

METABASE_SITE_URL.description: Browser-facing URL used for application links.

MICROBIN_ACCESS_PASSWORD.description: Password for site-wide HTTP Basic login, username ods.

MICROBIN_ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Separate administrator password; replaces the upstream default.

MOSQUITTO_PASSWORD.description: Exactly 64 hexadecimal characters for the local ods MQTT account; retain this credential for configured clients.

MUMBLE_SUPERUSER_PASSWORD.description: Distinct random 64-hex SuperUser password, reapplied at startup.

NATS_PASSWORD.description: Random 64-hex password for the local ods NATS user.

NEO4J_PASSWORD.description: Initial neo4j password: random 64 hexadecimal characters; not a reset for existing databases.

NEO4J_BOLT_PORT.description: Loopback host port used by native Bolt drivers and the browser.

NIFI_ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Random 64-hex password for the ods single-user administrator.

NIFI_SENSITIVE_PROPS_KEY.description: Independent random 64-hex flow encryption key; retain unchanged with backups.

NIFI_PUBLIC_URL.description: Browser URL; update together with NIFI_PORT if changing the published port.

NODE_RED_ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Editor and HTTP-flow password for user ods; 16 to 72 UTF-8 bytes.

NODE_RED_CREDENTIAL_SECRET.description: Stable 64-hex encryption key; retain with backups to decrypt flow credentials.

OLLAMA_MODEL.description: Default model to load on startup

OPENWEBUI_PIPELINES_PORT.description: Open WebUI Pipelines published host port

OPENWEBUI_PIPELINES_API_KEY.description: 64-hex management/client API key replacing the upstream shared default.

ORTHANC_PASSWORD.description: Random 64-hex password for the orthanc web/API account.

OWNCAST_ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Random 64-hex administrator password enforced on each startup.

OWNCAST_STREAM_KEY.description: Distinct random 64-hex RTMP stream key enforced for this deployment.

PAPERLESS_GPT_API_TOKEN.description: API token from your Paperless-ngx account.

PDFDING_SECRET_KEY.description: Persistent random Django signing secret, at least 32 characters.

PENPOT_DATABASE_PASSWORD.description: Random persistent password for the private PostgreSQL database.

PENPOT_SECRET_KEY.description: Persistent session/signing secret: generate 64 random bytes, URL-safe base64 encoded.

PENPOT_PUBLIC_URI.description: Browser-facing URL; update when changing the port or reverse proxy.

PENPOT_FLAGS.description: Local installation flags. Disable registration after creating accounts; see README before exposing remotely.

PGVECTOR_ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: 64-hex bootstrap administrator password; existing databases require SQL password rotation.

PGVECTOR_APP_PASSWORD.description: Distinct 64-hex password for ods_app, used by projects and authenticated health checks.

RABBITMQ_ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: 64-hex initial ods_admin password; existing accounts are preserved.

RABBITMQ_NODE_SECRET.description: Distinct stable 64-hex Erlang node/CLI cookie, preserved with backups.

RADICALE_PASSWORD.description: 64-hex password for DAV account ods; rotation requires updating configured clients.

REACTIVE_RESUME_DB_PASSWORD.description: 64 random hexadecimal characters for the dedicated PostgreSQL account.

REACTIVE_RESUME_AUTH_SECRET.description: Stable 64-hex authentication secret; retain with backups.

REACTIVE_RESUME_DISABLE_SIGNUPS.description: Set true after creating the intended accounts to close registration.

REST_SERVER_PORT.description: Restic REST Server published host port

REST_SERVER_PASSWORD.description: Random 64-hex password for the ods backup transport account; not the Restic encryption password.

RVC_API_KEY.description: API key for RVC service authentication (optional; leave empty to disable auth)

SFTPGO_SETUP_CODE.description: 64-hex installation code required by the native first-administrator setup wizard.

SFTPGO_SFTP_PORT.description: Loopback SFTP port for project clients.

SHIORI_INITIAL_PASSWORD.description: First-account password for username shiori: 12 to 72 UTF-8 bytes. Does not reset existing accounts.

SHIORI_HTTP_SECRET_KEY.description: Persistent random session signing secret, at least 32 random characters.

SHLINK_API_KEY.description: Distinct 64-hex initial management API key; use native API-key management for revocation.

SOLR_ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Random 64-hex initial ods administrator password; retain or rotate using the native security API.

SYNCTHING_GUI_PASSWORD.description: 64-hex initial password for GUI user ods; existing configured credentials are preserved.

SYNCTHING_SYNC_PORT.description: Loopback TCP synchronization listener; remote peers need deliberately configured reachability.

TRACCAR_DB_PASSWORD.description: 64-hex database password; existing PostgreSQL credentials require native rotation.

TRACCAR_DEVICE_PORT.description: Loopback OsmAnd protocol port; remote devices require explicit networking.

TYPESENSE_API_KEY.description: A long random API key for the Typesense server.

UMAMI_INITIAL_PASSWORD.description: Initial admin password: 12 to 72 UTF-8 bytes. Replaces only the unchanged upstream default.

UMAMI_DATABASE_PASSWORD.description: Persistent password for the dedicated PostgreSQL database.

UMAMI_APP_SECRET.description: Persistent random authentication secret of at least 32 characters.

UMAMI_TWO_FACTOR_KEY.description: Persistent 64-character hexadecimal encryption key for two-factor authentication.

VALKEY_PASSWORD.description: 64 random hexadecimal characters for the ods client account.

VAULTWARDEN_ADMIN_TOKEN.description: Random 64-hex administrator access token, separate from the vault master password.

VERDACCIO_PASSWORD.description: 64-hex password for the managed ods account. Changing it and restarting rotates login credentials.

VIKUNJA_SERVICE_SECRET.description: Persistent random signing secret; generate at least 32 random bytes.

VIKUNJA_SERVICE_PUBLICURL.description: Exact browser URL including port and trailing slash.

VIKUNJA_SERVICE_ENABLEREGISTRATION.description: Allow first account creation; set false after creating the required accounts.

WAKAPI_PASSWORD_SALT.description: Persistent random password pepper, at least 32 random characters. Back up and do not rotate casually.

WAKAPI_ALLOW_SIGNUP.description: Allow account creation during local setup; set false after creating desired accounts.

WALLABAG_INITIAL_PASSWORD.description: Initial ods administrator password, at least 12 characters; existing accounts are not reset.

WALLABAG_INITIAL_EMAIL.description: Email address for the initial ods administrator.

WALLOS_TIMEZONE.description: IANA timezone used by the native recurring-payment and notification scheduler.

WEBLATE_DB_PASSWORD.description: Random 64-hex PostgreSQL password; keep stable across recreation.

WEBLATE_ADMIN_PASSWORD.description: Distinct random 64-hex admin password, reapplied by native startup.

WEBLATE_ADMIN_EMAIL.description: Actual owner email for the administrator account; SMTP is configured separately.

WIKIJS_DB_PASSWORD.description: 64-hex private database password; browser administrator is created in native setup.
